tasks.description: Repo: crdt-merge-ts. ORSet in src/core.ts gains tombstones and element_types, as in the Python edition at crdt-merge 252c93e6. remove() writes a tombstone for every tag it observes instead of only clearing the tags, so a removed element does not come back after a merge. Tag lists and sets serialise in the canonical sort of PG-03.1. Jest runs from tests/.
